texts.caption:
Hello PDS family! We’re having our first volunteer event of the Fall quarter in collaboration with Keep Riverside Clean and Beautiful (KRCB)! It will take place on Thursday, October 1st from 9:30-10:30am on our adopted street, Spruce Street x Chicago Street.

Join us and your fellow pre-dents to help restore the streets and parks in our community, continuing the mission of keeping Riverside clean and beautiful! KRCB gives individuals the opportunity to take personal responsibility for city beautification, improving quality of life, and promoting the spirit of volunteerism in Riverside! 🌷

‼️ SIGN-UP FORM IS AVAILABLE IN THE LINKTREE IN OUR BIO! Please sign up by Wednesday, September 30th @ 6:00 PM!

ALL CLEANUP SUPPLIES WILL BE PROVIDED! (Gloves, vests, scrapers, graffiti clean-up kits, bags, etc)
Clothing: Must wear closed-toe shoes while participating. No sandals or flip flops.

🗓️October 1st @ 9:30-10:30 AM
📍1695 Spruce Street, Riverside, CA, 92507
✏️Sign up via the google form in our link tree or below by September 30th @ 6:00 PM
We hope to see you all there! 😁
